James Pace's children's story invites young readers to discover how a grumpy forest giant finds his place during the most wonderful time of the year.

Sasquatch On A Stump

TALLAHASSEE, Fla. - Nov. 9, 2026 - PRLog -- As snowflakes fall and holiday lights begin to twinkle, a grumpy forest dweller stumbles upon a mossy tree stump that will change his life forever. This enchanting winter scene sets the stage for James Pace's Sasquatch on a Stump, the second installment in the SquatchVerse™ Series, which continues to delight readers since its successful release and is available for purchase on Amazon and other major book retailers.

The story centers around a large, furry Sasquatch who prefers to keep to himself. However, discovering a special stump in the middle of the woods sparks an unexpected transformation. As the festive season approaches, he takes on the role of forest guardian, listening closely for the ringing of Christmas bells just in case his old friend Santa Claus needs a helping hand.

Designed for children ages 4 to 8, this beautifully illustrated holiday tale is perfect for cozy winter read-alouds. It gently guides little ones through themes of belonging, kindness, and discovering the true meaning of home, proving that even the biggest and grumpiest creatures have hearts of gold.

"I believe that once your mind is opened to the magic of mythical creatures, you'll be able to share this magical gift with others," Pace explains. Reviewers continue to praise the book as a delightful, feel-good story that reassures children everyone has a place to belong.

About the Author

James Pace earned his master's degree in special education from Florida State University, driven by a lifelong passion for helping children learn. He wrote Sasquatch on a Stump to invite young minds into a world of kindness and wonder. Residing in Tallahassee, Florida, he spends his free time enjoying the outdoors, woodworking with his son, Michael, and relaxing with his wife, Lisa, their three adult daughters, and the family pets.
